As a FOUP & Reticle Cleanroom Operator, you make sure these sensitive materials arrive safely, cleanly and on time. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be careful, responsible and comfortable with active work. Your role keeps you on the move throughout the cleanroom, supporting the production process behind the technology used to manufacture computer chips. What will you do? You work within ASML's FOUP & Reticle department in Veldhoven. FOUPs are special containers that protect semiconductor wafers against dust, contamination and damage during storage and transport. Reticles are highly precise glass plates containing the pattern of a computer chip. They play an essential role in the lithography process and must be handled with extreme care. You make sure FOUPs, reticles, tools and other materials reach the correct machines and production areas safely.
